caption:
If you answer late-night pings you don’t want, the pattern sets fast. Kind is better than available all the time.

Save this for the next message you’re tempted to answer at 10 pm.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

slides.headline: After-hours boundary
rows: “I saw your Slack. I’ll look at this tomorrow morning.”
“I’m always here if you need me.”
“If it’s urgent, call me. If not, email is fine.”
“I’m offline after work, so I won’t reply tonight.”
